purpose: Independent browser review of every Dyk surface on current main (#181 blind and constitutional audit, #399 final navigation/evidence/catalog review).

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-11 the owner asked in the controlling session to check whether #181 and #399 can be done by browser agents and then "do all. complete all work", and said "dont use AGY till 19:00. Use codex or claude agent to do the work." This campaign restarts the owner-stopped #181/#399 reviews on current Dyk main (Storybook on 127.0.0.1:6006 at fa3c2bc6) with the supervisor Claude browser worker only. Report-only web acceptance tasks: no code, branch, PR or issue-state change; the supervisor posts verified reports. Local Storybook only. No limits; provider subscription limits and the no-progress guard are the stops.

constraints: Report only: no file, branch, PR, label or issue-state change; the supervisor posts the verified report.
Browse only the declared local Storybook pages; never pidyk.app, a real account or another site; never submit forms with real data.
Never read .env contents, credentials or real user data; all stories use synthetic fixtures.
Measured evidence for layout claims (getBoundingClientRect via evaluate_script, emulate for phone widths); evaluate_script is for measurement only.

tasks.title: Tasks and task details
tasks.outcome: Independent browser acceptance of the tasks and task details for Dyk #181/#399: ACCEPTED, or findings with evidence.
tasks.goal: Surface: Tasks. #399 focus: Tasks -> evidence -> Back returns to the same task and scroll; corrected evidence single heading; RTL metadata. Open each declared story (switch globals locale:en|ru|he in the URL; use emulate for 320x568 and 390x844 phone widths). Act as a working parent of two school-age children (blind intent first: where am I, what brought me here, the 1-3 plausible next actions, can I complete them here without learning Dyk internals), then judge against the Constitution and PRINCIPLES U3/U6/U10/U12/U13/U14 and T2 (truthful states): no dead ends, no duplicate controls or repeated labels, 44px targets, no horizontal overflow, true Hebrew RTL, natural RU/EN/HE wording. Measure, do not guess. Interact only with Storybook controls; never submit real data. Report ACCEPTED only if every criterion passes in all three locales at both widths; list each failing criterion with story id, locale, width and evidence.
acceptance: The report starts with the Visual acceptance verdict and has a criterion/result/evidence table covering every declared story in RU/EN/HE at 320 and 390.
Every finding names story id, locale, width, the observed result and the violated principle; no finding is claimed without measured or visible evidence.
